final_message:
Fixed in `src/lru.py`. `get` never updated the recency order, so a key that was only read still looked like the oldest one and got evicted. `get` now moves the key to the most-recent position on a hit.

I ran your scenario: after `put(1,'a')`, `put(2,'b')`, `get(1)`, `put(3,'c')`, key 1 returns `'a'`, key 2 returns `None` (evicted), and key 3 returns `'c'`. I didn't run any other tests.
